name: @punch-bot/cli
description: Headless coding agent SDK, RPC, and print modes with read, bash, edit, write tools and session management

scripts.build:unbundled: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs executable dist/cli.js dist/rpc-entry.js && npm run copy-assets
scripts.build:binary: npm --prefix ../schema run build && npm --prefix ../telemetry run build && npm --prefix ../mcp run build && npm --prefix ../codemode run build && npm --prefix ../ai run build && npm --prefix ../agent run build && npm --prefix ../a2a run build && npm run build && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --no-compile-autoload-dotenv ./src/bun/cli.ts ./src/utils/image-resize-worker.ts ./src/extensions/codemode/worker.ts --outfile dist/pi && npm run copy-binary-assets
scripts.copy-assets: node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/core/theme/*.json" dist/core/theme && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy src/core/export-html/template.html src/core/export-html/template.css src/core/export-html/template.js dist/core/export-html && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js" dist/core/export-html/vendor
scripts.copy-binary-assets: node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md docs examples ../../node_modules/@silvia-odwyer/photon-node/photon_rs_bg.wasm dist && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/core/theme/*.json" dist/theme && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy src/core/export-html/template.html dist/export-html && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js" dist/export-html/vendor
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run shrinkwrap
